description: Wasserschutzgebiete Hamburg is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Behörde für Umwelt, Klima, Energie und Agrarwirtschaft (BUKEA). This WMS (Web Map Service) shows data on the Hamburg Water Protection Areas (WSG). Protected zones II and III are presented for publication on the Internet. In addition to the water protection areas established in accordance with §51 WHG (Water Resources Act) and §27 HWaG (Hamburg Water Act), the planned WSG will also be shown. Coverage: Behörde für Umwelt, Klima, Energie und Agrarwirtschaft (BUKEA). The portal shows the English title as "WMS Water Protection Areas Hamburg" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Behörde für Umwelt, Klima, Energie und Agrarwirtschaft (BUKEA). Its keywords include GDIMRH, Grundwasserschutz, Wasserschutz, Wasserschutzgebiet, Grundwasserförderung, Trinkwassergewinnung. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2019-09-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
